rules.effect: Even if you face confinement or hardship, you find release and are drawn to holy places and lasting spiritual freedom.
rules.effect_es: Aun si enfrentas encierro o dificultades, encuentras liberación y te inclinas hacia lugares sagrados y una libertad espiritual duradera.

rules.effect: You are drawn to public service and political activity.

rules.effect: Your livelihood can involve preparing medicinal mixtures, bearing arms, or work done close to fire.

rules.effect: You may succeed as a merchant, weaver, clothmaker, artist, or maker of fine curios, and are skilled in social and political affairs.

rules.effect_es: Llegas a ser un funcionario o una figura política destacada.

rules.effect: You become well known and respected in whatever line of work you follow.

rules.effect: You can do well making machinery and goods from metals such as gold, silver, and copper.
rules.effect_es: Puedes irte bien fabricando maquinaria y objetos de metales como oro, plata y cobre.

rules.effect: You are skilled in the use of weapons and instruments of war.
rules.effect_es: Eres hábil en el uso de armas e instrumentos de guerra.

rules.effect: You may earn your living trading in elephants.
rules.effect_es: Podrías ganarte la vida comerciando con elefantes.

rules.effect: You are carried toward final spiritual liberation.
rules.effect_es: Avanzas hacia la liberación espiritual definitiva.

rules.effect: In this period you earn from mining or hidden, behind-the-scenes means.
rules.effect_es: En este periodo ganas con la minería o con medios ocultos y discretos.
rules.timing_note: Verse also lists many afflictions (fire, eyes, stomach, teeth, deaths of elders); only the earning and family separation items are kept.

rules.effect: In this period you are separated from your partner and children.
rules.effect_es: En este periodo te separas de tu pareja y de tus hijos.

rules.effect: You gain wealth through religious people, rulers or soldiers, but you wander through distant lands with a troubled mind.
rules.effect_es: Ganas riqueza por medio de personas religiosas, gobernantes o soldados, pero vagas por tierras lejanas con la mente inquieta.

rules.effect: You gain wealth through relatives and friends and enjoy leisure with respected companions.
rules.effect_es: Ganas riqueza por medio de familiares y amigos y disfrutas del ocio con compañeros respetables.

rules.effect: You gain gems and gold and the favour of rulers.
rules.effect_es: Obtienes gemas y oro y el favor de los gobernantes.

rules.effect: You gain wealth honestly, honour the teachers, do good works and keep good company.
rules.effect_es: Ganas riqueza honradamente, honras a los maestros, haces buenas obras y te rodeas de buena compañía.

rules.effect: Trouble with relatives, low spirits, wasted money and little comfort mark this period.
rules.effect_es: Los problemas con familiares, el ánimo decaído, el dinero malgastado y la poca comodidad marcan este periodo.

rules.effect: You gain pearls or sea products but waste effort on fruitless debates and feel tired.
rules.effect_es: Obtienes perlas o productos del mar pero malgastas esfuerzo en debates inútiles y te sientes cansado.

rules.effect: In this period you gain access to sacred learning and teachers, and enjoy wealth, land, fine clothes and comforts.
rules.effect_es: En este periodo accedes al saber sagrado y a maestros, y disfrutas de riqueza, tierras, buena ropa y comodidades.

rules.effect: In this period you pursue learning and music, enjoy refined company, good health and growing renown.
rules.effect_es: En este periodo cultivas el estudio y la música, disfrutas de compañía refinada, buena salud y creciente renombre.

rules.effect: In this period you go on a pilgrimage with family and friends and gain land, livestock, wealth and power.
rules.effect_es: En este periodo haces una peregrinación con familia y amigos y ganas tierras, ganado, riqueza y poder.

rules.effect: You lose position, waste wealth, and have trouble with friends and siblings.
rules.effect_es: Pierdes posición, malgastas riqueza y tienes problemas con amigos y hermanos.

rules.effect: You suffer distress from enemies and waste money, with no ease.
rules.effect_es: Sufres angustia por enemigos y malgastas dinero, sin descanso.

rules.effect: You get vehicles, plenty of clothing and ornaments, and achieve what you strive for.
rules.effect_es: Consigues vehículos, abundante ropa y adornos, y logras lo que te propones.

rules.effect: Strain with your mother and hard words with unfriendly people weigh on you.
rules.effect_es: La tensión con tu madre y las palabras duras con personas poco amistosas te pesan.

rules.effect: Wealth comes from your mother's side, learned people seek your support, and you gain clothing and ornaments.
rules.effect_es: La riqueza llega por parte de tu madre, personas eruditas buscan tu apoyo y ganas ropa y adornos.

rules.effect: You lose property.
rules.effect_es: Pierdes propiedades.

rules.effect: A dowry comes from your partner's side and farming, cattle and clothing bring comfort.
rules.effect_es: Llega una dote de parte de tu pareja y la agricultura, el ganado y la ropa te dan comodidad.

rules.effect: You gain near-regal power, your enemies decline, and you enjoy happiness and prosperity.
rules.effect_es: Ganas un poder casi real, tus enemigos decaen y disfrutas de felicidad y prosperidad.

rules.effect: In this period you earn through weapons, conflict or medicine.
rules.effect_es: En este periodo ganas con las armas, el conflicto o la medicina.
rules.timing_note: Verse also lists fraud and cruel acts, fever, low company and bad food; only the livelihood sources are kept.

rules.effect: Friends and siblings turn against you, authorities threaten you, and your ventures fail.
rules.effect_es: Los amigos y hermanos se vuelven contra ti, las autoridades te amenazan y tus empresas fracasan.

rules.effect: You face danger from authorities and robbers, and lose wealth and grain.
rules.effect_es: Enfrentas peligro por parte de las autoridades y ladrones, y pierdes riqueza y grano.

rules.effect: You gain wealth and land through religious people, enjoy public esteem and rise.
rules.effect_es: Ganas riqueza y tierras por medio de personas religiosas, gozas de estima pública y asciendes.

rules.effect: Enemies, robbers and rulers threaten you and wealth is lost.
rules.effect_es: Enemigos, ladrones y gobernantes te amenazan y se pierde riqueza.

rules.effect: You gain wealth from trade, houses, cattle and grain, but suffer enemies and mental worry.
rules.effect_es: Ganas riqueza del comercio, casas, ganado y grano, pero sufres enemigos y preocupación mental.

rules.effect: You face trouble from relatives and siblings, and opposition from bad people.
rules.effect_es: Enfrentas problemas con parientes y hermanos, y oposición de gente mala.

rules.effect: You gain jewellery for your partner, clothing, and money from relatives.
rules.effect_es: Obtienes joyas para tu pareja, ropa y dinero de familiares.

rules.effect: You face blame and quarrels with your elders.
rules.effect_es: Enfrentas reproches y disputas con tus mayores.

rules.effect: You enjoy the comforts wealth affords: clothing, pearls, ornaments and deep rest.
rules.effect_es: Disfrutas de las comodidades de la riqueza: ropa, perlas, adornos y descanso profundo.

rules.effect: In this period you lose comfort, happiness and status, live away from home, and quarrel often.
rules.effect_es: En este periodo pierdes comodidad, felicidad y posición, vives lejos de casa y discutes a menudo.

rules.effect: You face a dispute, a clouded mind, wasted money and roaming in a far-off land.
rules.effect_es: Enfrentas una disputa, la mente nublada, dinero malgastado y vagar por tierras lejanas.

rules.effect: You gain royal favour, wealth, children and great perseverance, and obstacles clear.
rules.effect_es: Ganas el favor de los gobernantes, riqueza, hijos y gran perseverancia, y los obstáculos se despejan.

rules.effect: Relatives and friends are distressed and you live in a remote foreign land.
rules.effect_es: Tus familiares y amigos sufren y vives en una tierra extranjera remota.

rules.effect: You enjoy the company of friends and family, gain wealth and win royal favour.
rules.effect_es: Disfrutas de la compañía de amigos y familia, ganas riqueza y obtienes el favor de los gobernantes.

rules.effect: You suffer loss of wealth and honour, and misfortune of many kinds.
rules.effect_es: Sufres pérdida de riqueza y honor, y desgracias de muchas clases.

rules.effect: You gain vehicles and wealth from foreign lands, but have trouble with rivals and relatives.
rules.effect_es: Ganas vehículos y riqueza de tierras extranjeras, pero tienes problemas con rivales y familiares.

rules.effect: You turn to charity and contentment, and violence ceases.
rules.effect_es: Te inclinas por la caridad y el contento, y cesa la violencia.

rules.effect: You enjoy plentiful pleasures, good crops, money coming in, and time with family and friends.
rules.effect_es: Disfrutas de abundantes placeres, buenas cosechas, ingresos de dinero y tiempo con familia y amigos.

rules.effect: You feel bewildered, with setbacks in every undertaking.
rules.effect_es: Te sientes desconcertado, con contratiempos en cada empresa.

rules.effect: In this period you gain rank, wealth, vehicles, the goodwill of rulers, power, knowledge, a partner and children.
rules.effect_es: En este periodo ganas rango, riqueza, vehículos, la buena voluntad de gobernantes, poder, conocimiento, pareja e hijos.

rules.effect: In this period you gain royal favour, great diligence, success in what you attempt, and learning.
rules.effect_es: En este periodo ganas el favor de los gobernantes, gran diligencia, éxito en lo que intentas y saber.

rules.effect: You feel aversion and mental anguish, waste money through your children, and your business fails.
rules.effect_es: Sientes aversión y angustia mental, malgastas dinero por tus hijos y tu negocio fracasa.

rules.effect: You gain wealth through trade and royal favour, and are perfectly hospitable.
rules.effect_es: Ganas riqueza por el comercio y el favor de los gobernantes, y eres perfectamente hospitalario.

rules.effect: You gain pearl and coral ornaments, go on pilgrimages and grow richer, but suffer for elders and the ruler.
rules.effect_es: Obtienes adornos de perlas y coral, haces peregrinaciones y te enriqueces, pero sufres por tus mayores y el gobernante.

rules.effect: You gain vehicles and valuables and the glory of rank, but face trouble from women and public dislike.
rules.effect_es: Ganas vehículos, objetos de valor y la gloria del rango, pero enfrentas problemas con mujeres y rechazo público.

rules.effect: Your enemies flee and you gain victory, ease, diligence, wealth, royal favour and sound health.
rules.effect_es: Tus enemigos huyen y obtienes victoria, holgura, diligencia, riqueza, el favor de los gobernantes y buena salud.

rules.effect: You gain power, royal favour, material comfort, and fine clothing and ornaments.
rules.effect_es: Ganas poder, el favor de los gobernantes, comodidad material y ropa y adornos finos.

rules.effect: Your business fails, you wander, lose wealth, and feel depressed, with great risk.
rules.effect_es: Tu negocio fracasa, vagas, pierdes riqueza y te sientes deprimido, con gran riesgo.

rules.effect: Trouble comes from every side and your income is cut.
rules.effect_es: Los problemas llegan de todos lados y tus ingresos se reducen.

rules.effect: In this period you gain authority over a guild, town or village community.
rules.effect_es: En este periodo ganas autoridad sobre un gremio, un pueblo o una comunidad aldeana.
rules.timing_note: Verse also lists birds, donkeys, coarse grain, old women and rule over a low tribe; only the administrative authority is kept.

rules.effect: You feel envy and pride, which lead to sorrow, and rapacious rulers and robbers take your wealth.
rules.effect_es: Sientes envidia y orgullo, que te llevan a la pena, y gobernantes y ladrones rapaces te quitan la riqueza.

rules.effect: You face opposition and the displeasure of officials, and your family suffers.
rules.effect_es: Enfrentas oposición y el desagrado de los funcionarios, y tu familia sufre.

rules.effect: You gain happiness, wealth and fame, through piety, farming and commerce.
rules.effect_es: Ganas felicidad, riqueza y fama, mediante la piedad, la agricultura y el comercio.

rules.effect: You quarrel with unpleasant people and are troubled by dread and bad dreams.
rules.effect_es: Discutes con gente desagradable y te inquietan el temor y los malos sueños.

rules.effect: You enjoy the goodwill of relatives and the approval of people, and gain property, wealth and the joys of farming.
rules.effect_es: Gozas de la buena voluntad de tus parientes y la aprobación de la gente, y ganas propiedades, riqueza y las alegrías de la agricultura.

rules.effect: Sorrow and dislike from relatives mark this time, though money comes in.
rules.effect_es: La pena y la antipatía de los parientes marcan este tiempo, aunque entra dinero.

rules.effect: You lose position and feel anxious, and your siblings and friends are distressed.
rules.effect_es: Pierdes posición y te sientes ansioso, y tus hermanos y amigos están angustiados.

rules.effect: Robbers, foes and rapacious rulers devastate you, and your wealth is taken.
rules.effect_es: Ladrones, enemigos y gobernantes rapaces te devastan y te quitan la riqueza.

rules.effect: You are devoted to the divine, gain royal favour and great happiness and attain rank.
rules.effect_es: Te dedicas a lo divino, ganas el favor de los gobernantes y gran felicidad, y alcanzas rango.

rules.effect: In this period you earn through elders, relatives and friends, gain fame and happiness, and go on a mission or trade in gold goods.
rules.effect_es: En este periodo ganas por medio de mayores, parientes y amigos, obtienes fama y felicidad, y emprendes una misión o comercias con objetos de oro.

rules.effect: You gain fine houses and clothing, money through religious people and relatives, and succeed in every undertaking.
rules.effect_es: Obtienes casas y ropa finas, dinero por medio de personas religiosas y parientes, y triunfas en cada empresa.

rules.effect: You face trouble from relatives, mental agony, loss of comfort, dread of an enemy and failure in business.
rules.effect_es: Enfrentas problemas con familiares, angustia mental, pérdida de comodidad, temor a un enemigo y fracaso en los negocios.

rules.effect: You give gifts to elders and holy people, keep your duty, and gain wealth, clothing and ornaments.
rules.effect_es: Haces regalos a mayores y personas sagradas, cumples tu deber y ganas riqueza, ropa y adornos.

rules.effect: You gain apparel, ornaments and wealth, royal favour, great ease, and hear moral teaching.
rules.effect_es: Ganas ropa, adornos y riqueza, el favor de los gobernantes, gran holgura y escuchas enseñanzas morales.

rules.effect: You face ill will from enemies, and your undertakings fail.
rules.effect_es: Enfrentas la mala voluntad de enemigos y tus empresas fracasan.

rules.effect: Danger fades, and you gain fame through charity and royal favour.
rules.effect_es: El peligro se desvanece y ganas fama por la caridad y el favor de los gobernantes.

rules.effect: You gain wealth from friends and relatives, and win happiness, learning, ornaments and royal favour.
rules.effect_es: Ganas riqueza de amigos y familiares, y obtienes felicidad, saber, adornos y el favor de los gobernantes.

rules.effect: Friends, relatives and elders turn against you, though your wealth and children increase.
rules.effect_es: Amigos, parientes y mayores se vuelven contra ti, aunque tu riqueza y tus hijos aumentan.

rules.effect: You do charity and gain material comforts through minor chiefs, but suffer losses in farming.
rules.effect_es: Haces caridad y obtienes comodidades gracias a jefes menores, pero sufres pérdidas en la agricultura.

rules.effect: You face quarrels and the loss of relatives and friends.
rules.effect_es: Enfrentas disputas y la pérdida de parientes y amigos.

rules.effect: You suffer disappointment, exile in a foreign country, peril and obstruction in every business.
rules.effect_es: Sufres decepción, exilio en un país extranjero, peligro y obstrucción en todos los negocios.

rules.effect: Weariness affects your partner, children and attendants, your wealth and grain are destroyed, and your mind is distressed.
rules.effect_es: El cansancio afecta a tu pareja, tus hijos y tus ayudantes, tu riqueza y grano se destruyen y tu mente sufre.

rules.effect: Your children, partner and younger siblings resent you, and you face foes and bad rulers.
rules.effect_es: Tus hijos, tu pareja y tus hermanos menores te guardan resentimiento, y enfrentas enemigos y malos gobernantes.

rules.effect: You fear rulers and robbers, sorrow follows, your business is ruined and you quarrel with bad people.
rules.effect_es: Temes a los gobernantes y ladrones, sigue la pena, tu negocio se arruina y discutes con gente mala.

rules.effect: You win the goodwill of the divine, religious people and elders, and royal favour, and gain lands and children.
rules.effect_es: Ganas la buena voluntad de lo divino, de personas religiosas y de mayores, y el favor de los gobernantes, y obtienes tierras e hijos.

rules.effect: You enjoy relatives and friends, your partner and children gain wealth, and knowledge brings you happiness.
rules.effect_es: Disfrutas de parientes y amigos, tu pareja e hijos obtienen riqueza y el conocimiento te da felicidad.

rules.effect: This period brings you happiness.
rules.effect_es: Este periodo te trae felicidad.

rules.effect: This period brings you abundant wealth.
rules.effect_es: Este periodo te trae abundante riqueza.

rules.effect: This period brings you happiness.
rules.effect_es: Este periodo te trae felicidad.

rules.effect: This period brings you abundant wealth.
rules.effect_es: Este periodo te trae abundante riqueza.

rules.effect: This period brings you happiness.
rules.effect_es: Este periodo te trae felicidad.

rules.effect: This period brings you abundant wealth.
rules.effect_es: Este periodo te trae abundante riqueza.

rules.effect: In this period you gain a partner, children, wealth, comfort, fine clothes, vehicles and a king-like fortune and fame.
rules.effect_es: En este periodo ganas pareja, hijos, riqueza, comodidad, buena ropa, vehículos y una fortuna y fama dignas de un rey.

rules.effect: You gain wealth, fine clothing and a partner, do good works, and your enemies disappear as your fame grows.
rules.effect_es: Ganas riqueza, ropa fina y pareja, haces buenas obras y tus enemigos desaparecen mientras tu fama crece.

rules.effect: You suffer losses in land, livestock and property and the displeasure of rulers.
rules.effect_es: Sufres pérdidas en tierras, ganado y propiedades y el desagrado de los gobernantes.

rules.effect: You work hard, money comes in, and you gain land and a partner.
rules.effect_es: Trabajas mucho, entra dinero y ganas tierras y pareja.

rules.effect: You gain valuable dark-coloured goods, but relatives dislike you and friends do you harm.
rules.effect_es: Ganas bienes valiosos de color oscuro, pero los parientes te desprecian y los amigos te perjudican.

rules.effect: You gain wealth, clothing and ornaments, and keep your religious duties, leading to lasting happiness.
rules.effect_es: Ganas riqueza, ropa y adornos, y cumples tus deberes religiosos, lo que lleva a una felicidad duradera.

rules.effect: You gain houses, land and wealth, and your enemies disappear.
rules.effect_es: Ganas casas, tierras y riqueza, y tus enemigos desaparecen.

rules.effect: You enjoy the comfort of your children and friends, wealth, royal favour, happiness, prosperity and sound health.
rules.effect_es: Disfrutas del consuelo de tus hijos y amigos, riqueza, el favor de los gobernantes, felicidad, prosperidad y buena salud.

rules.effect: Discord, injury from enemies, misgivings and loss of wealth mark this time.
rules.effect_es: La discordia, el daño de enemigos, las dudas y la pérdida de riqueza marcan este tiempo.

rules.effect: Periods ruled by the planets that govern your luck and your core self tend to bring good results, even if those planets are harsh by nature.
rules.effect_es: Los periodos regidos por los planetas que gobiernan tu suerte y tu esencia tienden a dar buenos resultados, aunque esos planetas sean duros por naturaleza.

rules.effect: Periods ruled by the planets of your effort and gain areas tend to bring difficult results, even if those planets are gentle by nature.
rules.effect_es: Los periodos regidos por los planetas de tus áreas de esfuerzo y ganancia tienden a traer resultados difíciles, aunque esos planetas sean amables por naturaleza.

rules.effect: Periods ruled by the planet of your conflicts-and-debts area tend to bring difficult results, even if that planet is gentle by nature.
rules.effect_es: Los periodos regidos por el planeta de tu área de conflictos y deudas tienden a traer resultados difíciles, aunque ese planeta sea amable por naturaleza.
